name: Agri-Koushol - B. Sensor Feeder & Soil Telemetry Simulator

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  fieldId: $('Check Low Moisture').item.json.fieldId,
  action: $json.decision.decision || 'IRRIGATE',
  reasoning: $json.decision.reasoning || ('Soil moisture has dropped below threshold (' + $('Check Low Moisture').item.json.soilMoisture + '% < ' + $('Check Low Moisture').item.json.threshold + '%). Initiating autonomous irrigation.'),
  scheduledFor: $json.decision.rescheduleTimeIso,
  severity: $json.decision.severity || 'HIGH',
  farmerMessage: $json.decision.farmerMessage || ($('Check Low Moisture').item.json.fieldName + ': Low soil moisture (' + $('Check Low Moisture').item.json.soilMoisture + '%). Irrigation activated.'),
  farmerMessageBn: $json.decision.farmerMessageBn || ($('Check Low Moisture').item.json.fieldName + ': মাটির আর্দ্রতা কমে গেছে (' + $('Check Low Moisture').item.json.soilMoisture + '%)। স্বয়ংক্রিয় সেচ চালু করা হয়েছে।'),
  source: 'N8N',
  simulated: true
}) }}
